info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Operation By Param1-spec
info.description: The Market Operations Retrieval API allows users to fetch detailed information about market operations related to securities fails processing based on a specified parameter. This endpoint is particularly valuable for financial institutions, analysts, and traders who need to monitor and analyze market activities. By providing a unique identifier as a parameter, users can retrieve precise data that assists in decision-making and operational efficiency. Typical use cases include reporting, compliance analysis, and trade reconciliation.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific securities fail event.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific securities fail event identified by a unique ID. It provides insights into the status and handling of the fail, aiding users in issue resolution and operational oversight.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of securities fails processing for a specific operation identified by the RES-100045 code. The payload must follow the defined schema to ensure proper communication with the API.
